attempts.title: The Cumming Man
attempts.why: A death-row inmate sprinting for his life on a dystopian game show is so terrified/aroused he's perpetually ejaculating mid-sprint. The visual of him cumming while running from armed hostiles is absurd and darkly funny.

attempts.title: The Nutting Man
attempts.why: 'Nutting' is classic slang for ejaculation. A man jacking off the entire time he's being hunted across a wasteland adds a great contrast between grim survival and lewd self-pleasure.

attempts.title: The Butting Man
attempts.why: A man who keeps butting into everything — heads, situations, or literally butts. Mild sexual innuendo plus physical comedy of a guy headbutting obstacles while fleeing.

attempts.title: The Cumin Man
attempts.why: A man made entirely of cumin spice running around. Cute but not edgy enough; the joke falls flat without adult stakes.
